messages:
dina (producer): Uploaded Copperwell case raw interview + transcript: https://files.redwood/copperwell-raw.mp4 + copperwell-transcript.txt. Need legal on hero quote, partner PR alignment, and localization for FR/DE. Proposed global embargo: 2025-11-12 08:00 PT.

marta (prod-marketing): Thanks Dina. Copperwell wants a co-branded landing and a short hero that reads well in FR/DE. Can we keep hero <= 12 words and a one-line CTA to either "Read the deep dive" or "Register for the migration webinar"?

dina (producer): Hero candidate in transcript: "Redwood helped Copperwell cut inference spend 3.6x and remove tail spikes during peak traffic." (full quote in transcript).

jules (legal): Quick flags: change exact multiplier to approximate (~3x) unless finance approves the exact figure and dataset. Avoid absolute claims like "remove" (use "reduce"). Also: Copperwell's PR requests that local market teams get a +1 day embargo in EMEA for translation review — we need to confirm contract language allows staggered regional release. Please attach signed media release and the benchmark appendix. :mag_right:

remy (sales-ops): Routing ask: when the co-branded landing form submits, tag leads with source=case-copperwell and partner=copperwell. Route to queue SDR-Partners and notify #sdr-copperwell. Sample webhook we will use: ```
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood/lead-route \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"email":"{{email}}","source":"case-copperwell","partner":"copperwell","queue":"SDR-Partners"}'
```

kai (growth): I can run the landing variants and the webinar registration flow. Recommend a short 30-min "migration clinic" 10 days after embargo to capture technical buyers: proposed 2025-11-22 10:00 PT. Also suggest testing hero vs. CTA-first for conversion.

dina (producer): Copperwell PR asked to redact a single line that mentions a prior vendor. I've redacted and uploaded a new cut: copperwell-cut-v2.mp4. Please review captions and transcript.

translate-bot: starting automated machine translation for FR and DE. Artifacts will be in Drive under /i18n/copperwell/. Please review translations before publish.

jules (legal): Also confirm: because this will be co-branded, any partner quotes must be cleared by Copperwell PR. I'll require a final sign-off email from their comms lead as part of the legal approval. If Copperwell wants staggered regional embargoes, we need a short addendum signed.

marta (prod-marketing): OK — we'll plan for EMEA +1 day release (so global embargo 11/12 08:00 PT, EMEA live 11/13 08:00 PT) pending Copperwell sign-off. We'll surface both hero variants to design and localized hero strings for FR/DE.

remy (sales-ops): Automation detail: on lead creation set campaign=copperwell-co-brand-2025. If partner==copperwell add tag=partner-lead and notify #sdr-partners. I'll add a smoke test for routing on 2025-11-10.

kai (growth): For webinar, propose speakers: Copperwell infra lead, Copperwell SRE, Redwood Solutions Eng. Dina, can you draft a 1-pager and a 3-bullet demo agenda for CS?

dina (producer): Yep  will upload 1-pager and demo bullets by EOD Tue. Also uploaded raw perf CSV (raw-perf-copperwell.csv) and the new edit: https://files.redwood/copperwell-cut-v2.mp4.

jules (legal): I'll approve the following hero once I receive: final transcript, signed media release from Copperwell comms, and the benchmark appendix uploaded to the approval email. Approved hero pending attachments: "Redwood helped Copperwell reduce inference spend ~3x while smoothing peak latency."

marta (prod-marketing): Accepted. We'll use that hero on the landing and put the exact benchmark note in a footnote with a link to the appendix (readers must opt in to view the raw logs). Design will produce FR/DE hero copy and we will run a localization QA pass.

translate-bot: FR translation ready: /i18n/copperwell/fr/hero.txt. DE translation ready: /i18n/copperwell/de/hero.txt. Please confirm human review.

remy (sales-ops): Reminder: partner leads should also get a custom nurture sequence. I'll coordinate with Demand Gen to add a 3-email track that includes the webinar invite.

dina (producer): Timeline recap and owner flags:
- Copperwell PR sign-off on co-branding + regional embargo addendum: by 2025-11-05 (Copperwell comms)
- Legal sign-off + appendix attached: by 2025-11-06 (Jules)
- Final edits + localized hero copy: by 2025-11-08 (Dina + Design + Translate)
- Landing + lead routing + smoke test: by 2025-11-10 (Remy)
- Embargo global publish: 2025-11-12 08:00 PT (Marketing)
- EMEA localized publish: 2025-11-13 08:00 PT (Marketing)
- Webinar: 2025-11-22 10:00 PT (Growth)
If anyone sees a blocker, flag now.

jules (legal): I'll queue the approval email and wait for the appendix & Copperwell sign-off. Also note: no raw telemetry screenshots should be published in blog; use aggregated chart with ranges.

publish-bot: upload complete: copperwell-cut-v2.mp4 (202MB)

marta (prod-marketing): Great work. Keep embargo tight and only share with stakeholders on the approval thread. Dina, ping when 1-pager is live and I'll draft the landing copy.

dina (producer): Closing  assets uploaded, translation in flight, legal & partner looped. Will post updates here if anything changes.

marta (prod-marketing): Thanks team  end of thread.
